title: Design and synthesis of a novel chiral triptycene-based imine ligand for enantioselective epoxide ring-opening reactions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49217-49226
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07454A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mamta Guleria, Manpreet Kaur, Divya Tagra, Jyoti Agarwal
A novel chiral triptycene-based imine ligand has been designed, synthesized and then characterized using various spectroscopic techniques, including FT-IR, 1H NMR, 13C NMR, and HRMS for the asymmetric ring opening reactions.
